none: PAS CAM-085EE6: Roman Coin : Reverse side of flan only - A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA ROMANORVM] ; D/ D N VALENTINI[...]

A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right, holding standard and dragging captive. Mint is uncertain, AD 364-375. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALENTINI[...]. Reverse fields and exergue read: ? //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is…
